# CRules unification: current user-authorized task

Unify the active double-linked-list library and all eight original double_link.c functions onto CRules, with ONE shared implementation of the five canonical spatial predicates and their proofs, parameterized only by layout. Preserve exact master:lib/dll.v API and original idnode proof-body compatibility. This replaces the prior two-assertion-model design. Main uses --coq-rules CRules in controller init; handoff canonical argv must contain --CRules CRules. SLL remains unchanged and is regression checked. Do not touch upstream /home/yangfp/crtos source or crtosverify.

Scope: InitDoubleLinkList, IsDoubleLinkListEmpty, DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter, DoubleLinkListInsertNodeBefore, DoubleLinkListRmNode, DoubleLinkListGetHead, DoubleLinkListGetNext, DoubleLinkListLenGet, with original C bodies, all current spec variants, order/data/payload transfer, and deletion reset-to-self intact. No extra canonical nonnull/endpoint guards, no new assumptions or weakened guarantees.

Reference definitions frozen under this report's input_snapshots/dll.v, from crtosverify/master d215f73b69916cc5c7c01af752bca4b6f96b3530. Existing active common and accepted proofs are the reuse starting point, frozen under input_snapshots/workspace. Previous idmanager_dll_alignment evidence is historical, not evidence for the new model.

Library goal: a single layout-parametric CRules implementation containing the canonical predicates, 19 compatible reference lemma interfaces and valid address/unit/emp projection facts. Export DLL at literal DoubleLinklistType layout and XiziIdmanagerDLL at SysDoubleLinklistNode layout; XiziLocalDLL should be an actual module alias to the same SysDoubleLinklistNode instance (or equally transparent same-definition export), not another copy of definitions/proofs. All instances must share actual DLL.DL_Node, constructor, projections, record syntax, implicit parameters and unfold/simpl behavior. Shared record may live in a base module, re-exported transparently through DLL; ensure original proofs actually compile. No field-string equality axioms. Check explicit reflexivity tests that local/idmanager node types, payload assertion types and all five predicates are definitionally identical. Main will compile original master idnode and origin/idnode six proof families through local import wrappers unchanged except imports. The origin/idnode pre-existing nonzero Axiom remains ONLY in frozen compatibility wrapper; do not add it to common.

Legacy AddrDLL/XiziStoreADLL and strategy dependencies can remain explicitly isolated under their old naive_C_Rules model ONLY for historical non-target cases, provided active eight consumers never use their predicates. Do not copy another active library. Need not modify historical strategies if they compile as separate dependencies; active goal generation must select CRules explicitly. Maintained common/case_lib/manual must pass forbidden lemma/no Admitted/no extra Axiom checks. The original framework strategy dependencies' existing assumptions are audited separately.

## Shared library bootstrap run (InitDoubleLinkList)
This run uses QCIPLib/xizi/xizi_double_link_common/xizi_double_link_lib.v as its sole writable case_lib. Refactor that library and adapt target init C annotation only if needed. Generated files only via symbolic execution. Keep function body byte-equivalent. All other case libs, headers and strategies are read-only in this run. Reuse current complete CRules instance proofs instead of inventing replacements. Main will subsequently migrate seven case-local libraries through their own controller runs.

## Consumer runs
For cases other than init, shared common is read-only and the assigned C plus case-local case_lib are writable. Change active assertion imports/definitions/helpers from naive_C_Rules to CRules, keeping compatible XiziLocalDLL predicate names (now alias to idmanager instance) and DLL.DL_Node. Preserve spec semantics. Existing accepted helpers may be adapted in annotation seed; group workers only add own-suffixed helpers. Existing manual proof bodies are proof-pattern references until recompiled with current generated witnesses. Include necessary imports in seed for helpers used in proofs. No hardcoded algorithm simulation in spec.

Mandatory workflow: root AGENTS user instructions override older skill prose. Annotation and vc-checking fixed phase subagents, group-worker proving, controller-only acceptance/final-candidate-apply. Use only main-worktree coq_tooling.py check/debug for Rocq. Required symexec includes/slp preserved plus --CRules CRules. QCP MCP is annotation interaction only; use actual driver/cwd/args and record unsupported wrapper features honestly. Complete recoverable work in a single attempt.

## Operational lessons for subsequent consumer runs
All git diff/status/whitespace checks must be scoped to explicit allowed paths; the workspace carries unrelated historical files including denied directories. Never run unscoped git diff --check. Preserve earlier reports and do not read denied reference contents. For canonical symexec prefer controller._run_canonical_symexec using the run state and round target paths; it preserves prior manual as a backup and generates a fresh current skeleton. Direct driver invocation may retain an old manual instead of refreshing it. Existing solved manual text is reuse input only until checked against current CRules goals.

## VC planning and proof reuse
The task-level frozen, allowed proof-pattern reference for each case is /home/yangfp/QCIP/OUTPUT/xizi/xizi_double_link_common/reports/crules_unification/input_snapshots/workspace/SeparationLogic/examples/OUTPUT/xizi/<case>/source/<case>_proof_manual.v, where <case> is the assigned case identifier. These are the previously accepted manual proofs, not QCP_demos_human inputs. They use the previous assertion import, so reuse is only a candidate until current CRules compilation passes. The vc-checking owner should record the resolved absolute path in each proof_groups entry under proof_pattern_references with role=read-only-proof-pattern-reference; that group entry is forwarded into group_worker_input.json's vc_checking_plan. Group workers may reuse the unchanged witness proof bodies where valid, keeping the newly generated CRules imports and current witness statements.
